title: Nashville's Only Extended Reality History Tour
blurb:
Experience the history of Nashville in a way you’ve never seen before. This small-group walking tour blends expert storytelling with cutting-edge extended reality (XR) technology, allowing you to watch historic moments unfold right where they actually happened.
As you explore downtown on foot, lightweight XR headsets layer vivid historical scenes over today’s city streets. Stand in Riverfront Park as early frontier Nashville comes to life. Witness soldiers marching through downtown during the Civil War. See the past seamlessly integrated into the present — not in a museum, not on a screen, but in the exact locations where history was made.

This is not a virtual tour. It’s a fully guided, real-world experience led by a knowledgeable local historian who brings context, depth, and powerful storytelling that technology alone can’t provide. The XR visuals enhance the narrative, creating an unforgettable connection between past and present.
